correctness.rationale: Using Q={1,3,4,9,10,12} modulo 13, independent open-neighborhood face generation yields 598 faces and f=(13,78,221,195,78,13). The deterministic greedy Morse pairing produces exactly 286 legal pairs, leaves one critical vertex and 25 critical two-simplices and passes a topological sort across all 2067 Hasse edges. The Morse CW model has no 1-cells, so is a wedge of twenty-five 2-spheres integrally, independent of finite-field rank extrapolation. Assigned package also includes the complete stored 286-pair and 598-face topological-order certificate; its verification source was examined.
